title: DUST HANGS IN THE LAMP LIGHT
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 9, atmosphere), in the gritty grounded look he picked. At night, and in the lamp hours of dawn and dusk, every lamp in view now has a few motes of dust drifting slowly through its pool of light and catching its colour: about five a lamp, more in fog, three on low effects. A flickering lamp dims its dust with it; a lamp that is out has none. Each mote moves on the raid clock alone, so nothing random is drawn and nothing is stored. Under the fog of war like the light itself. Drawing only.
now: Dust drifts through the lamp light at night.
